points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Fresh immutable 6148b7b CMake build passed in network-disabled cfd-bench, 2 CPUs/3 GiB/256 processes; CTest found no registered tests. Historical executable remains unbound.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:34,61 parses --restart, but no later reference to restartFile exists and no state is loaded. The output writer creates binary state files; parsing alone does not implement restart.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate case config, CGNS reader, mesh, partitioner, flux, reconstruction, solver, output, and plotting modules are present.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal executable wrapper is visible in the submitted C++/scripts. Trust policy forbids external similarity investigation, so originality beyond this direct inspection is unverified.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: case_config.hpp reads JSON case parameters and main.cpp uses --case; no two-benchmark-filename-only branch was found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: 6148b7b main.cpp:105–137 constructs a full mesh on every rank, holds it through solver loops and uses it again :409; TASK.md:46,227 prohibit this despite actual METIS and neighbor halos. Historic rank packages require further review.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: main.cpp:274–276 assigns converged after max steps irrespective of residual; historical M200 laminar reports converged after residual growth, and Re200 success fraction is clamped in output.hpp:406–408.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean immutable-source build passed; CTest reports no registered tests. Historical result packages were recovered; no evaluator CFD run or Re200 rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Header-oriented C++ is modular; report final-force table conflicts with checkpoint histories, restart is ignored, and metadata convergence fraction is clamped.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative perfect-gas state, fluxes, and Reynolds-derived viscosity are implemented/described.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS reader, mixed-element geometry, faces, centers, volumes and graph structures are present in source.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.hpp computes face residual and global reductions; checkpoint histories exist but no independent conservation run or production-binary binding was established.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Roe/Harten-Hyman and Rusanov implementations exist. output.hpp always identifies Roe even when --rusanov selects Rusanov, so metadata fidelity is defective.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Source has farfield/slip/no-slip branches; output.hpp:86–87 writes explicit zero wall velocities, and recovered checkpoint surface.csv files are available. This verifies output semantics, not physical wall resolution.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: reconstruction.hpp implements least-squares gradients and limiter; main.cpp:167–170 forces first-order transient, disclosed by report.tex:159–160. Steady first-order startup switch depends on runtime options.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-Jespersen-style limiter plus density/pressure fallback/revert logic is present.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.hpp:596–610 computes full viscous traction, including normal stress, in reported force split; rubric requires tangential skin friction. Numerical viscous results and negative M2 viscous drag are independently limited.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS-like sweeps and case CFL controls are present; checkpoint steady cases stopped at 5000 or 20000 steps, with mixed residual reduction and source unconditionally labeling budget exhaustion converged.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: main.cpp:280–329 implements BDF2 inner structure; recovered Re200 records five inner iterations and final ratio0.915 vs 0.001. Report.tex:159–160 says five, but :172 says one; binary is unbound.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: 6148b7b main.cpp:105–137 constructs a full mesh on every rank, holds it through solver loops and uses it again :409; TASK.md:46,227 prohibit this despite actual METIS and neighbor halos. Historic rank packages require further review.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Extracted checkpoint 99413eb contains all eight canonical packages; read-only validator passes layouts. Re200 and some steady statuses are physically unsupported and full-mesh metadata falsely says no replication.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit read-only validation of checkpoint 99413eb eight case directories plus its report returned OK for all nine paths; validator accepted clamped convergence fraction and does not prove physical correctness.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Recovered eight cases replace previous absent-data finding: Re200 t300 has no resolved street and last ratio0.915 misses0.001; M200 laminar residual grows0.468 orders, Re20 falls only0.584 orders.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Checkpoint histories show distinct outcomes: M015 inviscid late Cd0.050–0.064; M200 Mach outlier≈719; M200 laminar negative viscous drag and rising residual; Re20 Cd4.309; Re200 Cd3.404/no resolved street.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Checkpoint delivers manifest-listed per-case force/residual/Mach/pressure images; accepted 11-page PDF embeds nine figures. Re200 late lift/drag flattened, M200 Mach outlier flattens its image, and Re200 Mach title says velocity_magnitude despite selecting Mach data.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Submitted report.tex:141–148 force table conflicts with checkpoint results; :159–160 acknowledges five inner iterations but :172 says one. The report discloses no resolved street, but figure caption claims shedding; late force plot is unreadable.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Checkpoint 99413eb supplies result packages and figure manifest, unlike curated tip. Exact historic binary unbound; several report table coefficients and rank/run descriptions disagree with selected data.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean immutable build succeeded; CTest has no registered tests. --restart is parsed but never applied, so CLI/restart contract is incomplete; historical packages exist.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS unstructured reader, boundary tags, geometry and cell-face graph construction are source-evidenced; mixed/multi-zone behavior is not executed.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Source face residual, Roe/Rusanov and BC branches exist. Recovered historical outputs permit physical assessment but do not replace independent conservation/binary validation.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Least-squares reconstruction, Barth limiter and positivity fallback are present; production accuracy cannot be demonstrated and fallbacks are material.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Newtonian/Fourier flux and wall gradients exist, but solver.hpp:596–610 integrates full traction including normal component in the viscous split rather than tangential skin friction; numerical results have additional limits.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: LU-SGS/BDF2 source; checkpoint Re200 records five inner iterations and last ratio0.915 vs 0.001, while report has contradictory one/five claims. Steady budget-exhaustion status is unconditional.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: Actual METIS and neighbor halos, but 6148b7b main.cpp retains full per-rank mesh during solver execution, violating TASK.md:46,227. Historical rank comparisons require full review.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Recovered checkpoint has eight cases: four NACA results with partial force settling, M200 laminar growing residual and negative shear, Re20 high Cd, Re200 no resolved street and final inner miss. Some plots/fields and rank packages are delivered, with numerical-summary/report inconsistencies.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: 11-page compiled report includes equations and nine images; separately delivered checkpoint has all-case plots/manifest. Force table mismatches results, transient inner-count prose contradicts itself, Re200 late forces are unreadable and M200 Mach outlier compresses the field.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separate case config, mesh, partition, reconstruction, flux, solver and output modules, but compact 2-D architecture.
